sw19-s7.name: The one-sixteenth paragraph, step 7 from #320: "put the armor back on"
sw19-s7.text: That works out to about one-sixteenth of the grown-ups per child that our brains evolved with (Perry, 2023). So the emptiness you feel (the "Void") is real, since it's what that missing company feels like. Once you've de-armored, going back to a lonely life will tend to feel worse than it did with the armor on. So gather a tribe of people you're close to and see most days, or you'll eventually put the armor back on just to get through the loneliness.
